description: Owner test/zaq/agent/http_request_flow_integration_test.exs. Tests first through Executor Factory Jido http_request. Scope loopback policy to target port. Persist provider and encrypted API key credential, assert raw stored ciphertext and header injection only at target. Assert exact target method/path/query/body and real LLM result, final answer and no secret leaks. Reject POST without credential before authenticated POST. Reuse existing stub max_interactions7 and monitored cleanup.

comments.text: Real flow reproduced QUERY transport failure: HttpClient converts QUERY to :query; Finch rejects unsupported atom and requires binary method. User explicitly requested filing GitHub issue, removing QUERY from Flow2 scope and continuing with GET OPTIONS PUT DELETE plus denied/authenticated POST. Do not modify production transport.

Revised six-message real flow passes: GET OPTIONS PUT DELETE -> POST401 without credential -> POST200 with persisted credential_id. Assertions cover literal received method/path, encoded query and JSON body, zero/one secure header count, exact expected key verification at server without echoing secret, raw stored ciphertext, no secret in any LLM request/args/result/final answer. Existing HTTP/policy/credential/tool + Flow1 regressions pass (95 tests +5 properties). Only new test and handbook changed; production untouched. Read-only review found no actionable gaps.

title: [zaq-48o] Implement real HTTP method and credential agent flow
